summary: Full-width hero over a tilted wall of 6-10 real photos (team, office, the work itself) tinted in the brand colour, with a very large bold centered heading, a short centered lead and centered buttons (Kyanon Digital's hero). The photos fade in on load and alternate rows drift sideways a little as the page scrolls. Needs 6 or more photos: the client's own team and office photos are best, library photos are allowed. Suits companies with a people or culture story, or with many service lines that one picture cannot show. Keep the title short: it is set very large and should break into two lines.
